propositions: Documentation incorrectly claims bug tickets are gate-exempt; the actual code reviews bugs under the bug tier without blocking them
The docstring in review_plan docstring falsely states bugs are exempt; review_plan should describe the bug review tier instead
Bug review tier (epic 6982) performs a LIGHT ADVISORY review with DET floor + necessity probe, never blocks, and always passes; this behavior is correct but undocumented
Claim-time bug exemption (CLI-side, rebar._commands.gates) is separate from gate-review exemption and should not be conflated
session_log, code_review, and identity are the only true gate-exempt types with runner=exempt
Acceptance criteria require updates to docs/plan-review-gate.md and src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py to reflect actual behavior, with no code changes needed
